stem.text: The compound $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{NAlCl}_3$ has a simple molecular structure.

A.text: $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{NAlCl}_3$ molecules attract each other by hydrogen bonds.

B.text: The Al atom in $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{NAlCl}_3$ has an incomplete valence shell of electrons.

C.text: The bonds around the Al atom are planar.
